text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the embeddings-cache MVP cut by EOD Fri. Customer X wants lower egress cost for their pilot next week, asking if we can ship a lighter version. Proposals?
Eli: Clarify: by lighter do you mean drop disk persistence / async warmup and keep only in-memory prefix caching? that reduces infra work but hurts cold starts.
Jordan: My vote: remove async persistence + drop multi-tenant eviction polish. keep prefetch and stable cache key API. saves ~2w dev and still hits cost target.
Sam: +1 from CS side — Customer X said they're ok with slightly higher cold latency for the pilot if cost drops. they prefer quicker rollout.
Priya: OK sounds reasonable. so MVP scope = in-memory prefix cache + stable cache-key contract + no persistence. move persistence + metrics dashboard to v1. anyone object?
Eli: No objection. will need to rework tests and adjust load tests. I can own the PRD edits.
Jordan: Can infra book a canary slot? if we can internal-canary Wed we can start pilot next week.
deploy-bot: sched: canary window booked Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC for embeddings-cache-mvp. CI passing + canary-run required.
Sam: I'll draft customer comms and migration notes. heads-up: batch clients need a small adapter change (non-blocking).
Priya: Action items: Eli -> update PRD + test plan; Jordan -> infra ticket + canary prep; Sam -> comms + adapter plan. I'll update roadmap and tell sales. :thumbsup:
Eli: On it. ETA PRD update tomorrow noon.
Jordan: Opening infra ticket in ~30m.
Sam: Comms draft will be in #customer-success by EOD.
